purpose: Measure whether the exact Knight Arachne V6 uniform-valid sampling schedule starves sparse per-bone active support, and compare exposure-only active-balanced counterfactual schedules without training or model mutation.

arms.description: Exact V6 schedule replay: uniform sampling without replacement from teacher_valid rows.
Exposure-only counterfactual: attempt one distinct positive-support row per teacher target column each step, fill remaining budget uniformly from valid rows.
Exposure-only counterfactual: attempt four distinct positive-support rows per teacher target column each step, fill remaining budget uniformly from valid rows.

frozen_metrics: number of target columns with any zero-active step
claim_boundary: No optimizer step, model inference, topology inference, or product mutation is allowed.
Teacher data are used only to measure training exposure and construct diagnostic counterfactual schedules.
Counterfactual active-balanced schedules are not claimed to reproduce SkinTokens source exactly; they test the causal exposure principle under the same row budget.
All schedules remain within teacher-valid rows and therefore cannot solve the teacher-invalid supervision hole.
